scope: Close the remaining evidence gap for Temporal/LOD/aliasing stability and the severe-shimmer / visible-LOD-pop critical defects without awarding visual points from source code.

changes.summary: Machine-readable native-4K temporal evidence contract with subpixel-grazing and far-to-near LOD-walk probes, pixel-exact crop policy, SHA-256 sealing and zero automatic visual points.
Deterministic 3840x2160 frame-sequence capture, per-frame 100% crops, LOD inventory, SHA-256 manifest/receipt sealing, and pixel-by-pixel crop provenance validation.
Temporal category now requires both sealed motion probes; shimmer critical requires both; visible LOD pop requires the LOD-walk probe.

Numeric Visual Fidelity evaluator now validates sealed temporal evidence and observedTemporalRefs in addition to still-frame provenance. Still images alone can no longer clear temporal hard minimum or dismiss shimmer/LOD critical defects.

staticChecks: Temporal contract requires exactly two named native-4K probes and pixel-exact 100% crops.
Visual gate observability allowedTemporalRefs is exact-set validated against subpixel_grazing and lod_walk_oblique.
Temporal category requires two temporal refs; severe_aliasing_or_shimmer requires two; visible_lod_pop requires lod_walk_oblique.
Temporal evidence validation recomputes manifest/receipt SHA-256, every frame/crop SHA-256, PNG dimensions and every crop pixel against its source frame.
No source-side temporal check contributes Visual Fidelity points.

expectedVisualScoreImpactAfterRealEviden.temporal_lod_aliasing: Makes the 5-point category genuinely observable across motion rather than inferable only from three still frames.
criticalDefects: severe_aliasing_or_shimmer can no longer be marked absent without both native-4K temporal probes.
visible_lod_pop can no longer be marked absent without the native-4K LOD-walk probe.

nextBlocker: Actual Unity 6000.3.0f1 runner/editor execution. When available, stop speculative expansion, capture+seal the native still set and both temporal probes, review the exact 100% evidence for shimmer/LOD transitions, then score/fix only observed defects.
